name: Spotify
description: Spotify music integration: search, saved-track library, playlists, playback control, and device handoff with managed OAuth or a self-hosted Spotify app.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.help: Spotify application client ID (only needed for self-hosted local mode)

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client Secret
SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Spotify application client secret (self-hosted local mode)

SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN.label: Refresh Token
SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN.help: Long-lived refresh token for local mode, obtained via a one-time authorization-code grant

SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI.label: Redirect URI
SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI.help: OAuth redirect URI registered on the Spotify application
